sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Deptt. Home Civil Sectt. Lko And
Counsel for Applicant :- Vyas Narayan Shukla
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perused the record.

2. Initially a mission person report was lodged, subsequently, in the statements of the victim recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C., the victim did not support the prosecution story and stated that both of them had married.
There is no document with regard to the age of the victim as prescribed in the Juvenile Justice Act and the Rules framed there under, which is to be determined at the time of trial.
The applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 10.06.2023.
3. Learned A.G.A. opposed the bail prayer.

Mukesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109371543/
1 4.

entities.text: Mukesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Considering the said two statement of the victim recorded under Sections 161 & 164 Cr.P.C.
coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history and is in custody since 10.06.2023 and there is nothing on record to demonstrate that the applicant if enlarged on bail, would in any way adversely affect the trial and without expressing any opinion on merit, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

5. Let the applicant Mukesh Kumar be released on bail in FIR/ Case Crime No. 205 of 2023, under Sections 363, 376 IPC and Section 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Kotwali Nagar, District Raebareli,
on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 16.1.2024 Arun  Mukesh Kumar vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109371543/
